answer: An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The thread schedule is applied in nadir and tide shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 59% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 533 identities would post 4707 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
